title: Command Grove: cascading panels and contextual cost strips for workspace switching and rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: The current console sidebar and workspace switcher mix global navigation with per-workspace operational controls (rollouts, cost views, model variants). Engineers and PMs report context loss when toggling workspaces during incident responses or rollout monitoring. Goal: introduce a lightweight, keyboard-friendly cascading panel pattern ("Command Grove") that surfaces nearest-context controls and a new compact cost strip for quick comparisons without leaving the current canvas. The pattern should scale across multi-tenant accounts and work with the Console's existing rollouts UX (canaries, A/B).
acceptance_criteria: Cascading panels open from a single chevron / command icon in the left rail and stack without covering primary editor content (desktop breakpoint >= 1024px).
Panel items are keyboard navigable (arrow keys) and expose ARIA roles for screen readers; initial keyboard nav tests pass WCAG 2.1 AA basic scenarios.
Contextual cost strips show per-route token cost, recent 24h delta, and a one-click drift link to the Cost Dashboard.
Workspace switching in the grove performs a soft-switch (preserve open editors/drafts) with a visible toast and an option to open fully in a new tab.
Rollout entries include inline health indicators and a quick 'rollback' affordance that links to the rollout detail page; engineers can wire backend toggle via rollout-1.14 API.
Prototype validated with 6 internal users (2 PMs, 2 SREs, 2 ML engineers) showing >70% preference over current sidebar baseline for quick context tasks.
Design tokens and CSS variables are included in the handoff package and match console-2025.11 theme tokens.
tasks: Design exploration (3 variants): shallow drawer, cascading grove, modal hub -> deliver Figma frames
Microcopy audit for workspace names and rollout verbs
Accessibility pass: keyboard flows + aria labelling
Prototype user test (6 participants) and synthesize findings
Handoff: provide redlines, tokens, motion specs, and Figma component kit
Sync with frontend eng on integration points and fallback when JS disabled
design_decisions: Use cascading panels instead of deep nested sidebar menus to minimize context switching and preserve horizontal space for main canvas.
Introduce a compact 'cost strip' component (44px high) that can exist inline under panel headers for quick glance metrics.
Soft workspace switch by default; hard switch available via cmd/ctrl+enter or 'Open full workspace' CTA.
Health indicators are 3-state: healthy, degraded, critical; color blind safe palette and paired textual label.
Motion: panels slide in with a 180ms ease-out and 20ms stagger to help users track origin point.
blockers: Routing API requires a small change to support 'softSwitch' param (ENG-req: backend change).
Cost telemetry endpoint needs a summarized 24h delta field to render cost strips without extra aggregation queries.
SRE requested rollout quick-action gating until rollback audit logs are mapped to customer incidents.
